name: Sunrest Lifescience Ltd.
summary: Sunrest Lifescience Ltd. is an India-based pharmaceutical company primarily engaged in the marketing and distribution of a diverse range of healthcare and personal care products within the domestic market. The company operates on an asset-light business model, outsourcing manufacturing to third-party producers and focusing its core competencies on product selection, marketing, and distribution. Its extensive product portfolio includes both over-the-counter (OTC) and prescription-based pharmaceutical formulations, encompassing tablets, capsules, ointments, injectables, syrups, and various other forms. Sunrest Lifescience caters to numerous therapeutic segments, including anti-bacterial, anti-diabetic, anti-fungal, anti-hypertensive, analgesic, nutritional, ayurvedic, and cosmetic products. The company primarily targets consumers in India, with significant market presence and a network of distributors and retailers across states such as Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Orissa.
